name: Peaks extraction with MRtrix
summary: Computes fibre orientation distributions from DWI with MRtrix3 constrained spherical deconvolution (CSD, multi-shell or 5TT) and extracts the peaks with sh2peaks, using TractSeg's code.
description: Uses TractSeg's MRtrix wrapper to estimate the response function and FODs with the selected CSD type, then extracts the FOD peaks at each voxel with sh2peaks; the peaks image is the input expected by TractSeg. A brain mask is computed from the T1w with FSL bet when none is given. The T1w must be skull-stripped and aligned with the DWI; multi-shell DWI is needed for the msmt options.

inputs.description: T1w image. It should be aligned with the dwi data and all non-brain tissue should be removed.
Brain mask. It should be aligned with the dwi data. If not provided, the BET algorithm will be used for brain extraction.

citations.text: Tournier J-D, Calamante F, Connelly A. MRtrix: Diffusion tractography in crossing fiber regions. Int J Imaging Syst Technol 22:53-66 (2012).
